errors.text_span: Някои от стълбовете са групирани заедно с по-малки стойности, докато други са самостоятелни с по-високи стойности.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that some bars are 'grouped together'. This is a standard bar chart where each bar corresponds to a single date on the x-axis, not a grouped bar chart. This statement misrepresents the fundamental structure of the plot.

The prompt asks for representative values from the shortest and highest bars. The description gives a value for the highest bar but does not provide a value for the shortest non-zero bar, such as the one for 3/3/2024 (approx. 0.2) or 3/14/2024 (approx. 0.3).
